segmente.text: A marketing secret you must never ignore is that people don't read, they scan.
Most people read in the F and Z shaped patterns.
Your eyes go from 1 to 2 to 3 to 4 and finally to 5.
The words in your text don't have to be spelled correctly to be understood.
Therefore, while building a website, make it scannable.
And while making an ad, make it scannable too.
